title: Wider systems for linear logic with fixed points: proof theory and complexity
summary: We investigate infinitary wellfounded systems for linear logic with fixed points, with transfinite branching rules indexed by some closure ordinal $α$ for fixed points. Our main result is that provability in the system for some computable ordinal $α$ is complete for the $ω^{α^ω}$ level of the hyperarithmetical hierarchy. To this end we first develop proof theoretic foundations, namely cut elimination and focussing results, to control both the upper and lower bound analysis.
